title: Toward a Semiparametric Efficiency Theory under Equality Constraints in Nested Markov Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.24602v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probabilistic models of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) with latent variables impose equality constraints on the observed data distribution beyond ordinary conditional independencies. These so-called Verma constraints arise in nested Markov models associated with Acyclic Directed Mixed Graphs, the latent projection of latent-variable DAGs. While nested Markov models have been extensively studied from the perspectives of graphical representation and causal identification, their implications for semiparametric efficiency theory remain less understood. We develop results toward establishing a semiparametric framework for statistical models defined by Verma constraints. Our key observation is that nested Markov constraints admit weighted conditional-moment representations under post-fixing distributions induced by graphical fixing operations. translated_title: 在嵌套马尔可夫模型中等式约束下的半参数效率理论探索
translated_abstract: 摘要：具有潜变量的有向无环图（DAG）的概率模型对观测数据分布施加了超越普通条件独立性的等式约束。这些所谓的Verma约束出现在与无环有向混合图（即潜变量DAG的潜投影）相关的嵌套马尔可夫模型中。尽管嵌套马尔可夫模型在图形表示和因果识别方面已被广泛研究，但其对半参数效率理论的影响仍知之甚少。我们开发了结果，以建立由Verma约束定义的统计模型的半参数框架。我们的关键观察是，嵌套马尔可夫约束在由图形修复操作诱导的后固定分布下承认加权条件矩表示。我们表明，修复在L2(P)中诱导加权正交关系，从而将Verma约束转化为可处理的半参数效率分析形式。
tldr: 本文首次将嵌套马尔可夫模型中的Verma约束转化为加权条件矩表示，并通过图形修复操作建立半参数效率理论框架，为处理潜变量DAG的统计推断提供了新方法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a semiparametric efficiency framework for nested Markov models by converting Verma constraints into weighted conditional-moment representations via graphical fixing operations, offering new insights for statistical inference with latent-variable DAGs.
